en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin yahya, from Sa’d Bin Abdullah, from Ibrahim Bin Muhammad Al Saqafy, from Ali Bin Al Moalla, from his brother Muhammad, from Dorost Bin Abu Mansour, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the (parents of) Prophet<sup>saww</sup> were blessed, he<sup>saww</sup> remained for days, there wasn’t any milk for him<sup>saww</sup>. So Abu Talib<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> cast him<sup>saww</sup> upon his<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> own breast, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sent down milk from it. So he<sup>saww</sup> breast-fed from him<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> for days until Abu Talib<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> came to Haleema Saeeda, so he<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> handed him<sup>saww</sup> over to her’.
en.sarwar: 27. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi from Ali ibn Mu‘alla from his brother, Muhammad from Durust ibn abu Mansur from Ali ibn abu Hamza from abu Basir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“When the Holy Prophet (s.a) was born he remained for days without milk. Abu Talib himself breast fed him and Allah sent milk through his nipples. It continued for several days until abu Talib found Halima al-Sa‘diya and the child was given to her”
